other_failure_modes.name: Cross-series feature leakage in rolling windows
other_failure_modes.description: When computing rolling features on a grouped time series, applying `.rolling()` directly to the flat Series output of `.shift()` ignores group boundaries. This causes values from the end of one time series to incorrectly leak into the rolling window at the start of the subsequent time series in the sorted dataframe, corrupting the features.

other_failure_modes.name: Unsafe index resetting on grouped rolling features
other_failure_modes.description: Calling `.reset_index(drop=True)` on the MultiIndex Series returned by a grouped rolling operation and assigning it directly back to the original dataframe relies on implicit row order alignment. This is extremely brittle and can easily scramble features if the group processing order differs from the dataframe's row order.
